# AGENTS.md

## Applies to

This card applies to `.github/` and its descendants.

## Role

The GitHub district owns source-validation workflow wiring and repository
review metadata. It does not change the dashboard's organ boundary or grant
runtime, access, proof, or acceptance authority.

## Validation

Keep the `Repo Validation` workflow aligned with the repository-owned
contract validator and unit-test route. Changes to workflow permissions,
required checks, or landing posture must be reviewed against
`docs/RELEASE_POSTURE.md`.
